correction: The promoted cumulant representation is controlled, but the physical edge kernel K is already exactly finite harmonic (0,+1,-1). Approximating exp(P_N) would add harmonics without addressing the hard l1 norm over charge records. The next prerequisite is therefore an exact coarse-charge contraction using K itself.
question: Can nested exact charge-prefix observations tighten the L5,p=.08 Bayes-LER upper bound while keeping the record state space bounded?
frozen_model: Canonical open square, exact ternary physical prior, full logical parity and rough endpoints. Marginalize unselected public charges and retain selected charges exactly; more observed charges can only reduce Bayes risk.

method.transfer: Assign each exact physical edge current once in a frontier contraction. Track frontier currents, logical parity and a tuple of selected detector charges.
method.bound: For selected detector set S, LER_full<=sum_{Q_S} min[Z0(Q_S),Z1(Q_S)]. This is an exact information-monotonic upper bound, not a kernel approximation.
method.selection: Use nested suffixes of the minimum-width elimination order so added observations are deterministic and resource growth is measured before earlier charges are retained.
method.baseline: Compare with the completed k=4 activity interval.

acceptance: All transfer masses normalize to one, nested coarse risks are nonincreasing, and full L3 observation reproduces frozen exact LER within 1e-12.
Promote a selected-count level only where its upper bound reduces the activity interval width by at least 10%; report resource states and exact selected vertices.
Fail closed at two million transfer states. If the cap is reached, mark that and do not infer the unrun larger subset.
Retain the Wiener result as a representation theorem, but do not spend compute on finite-harmonic K_N unless exact-K charge contraction first shows information value.
stop_rule: Stop at the first registered selected count that exceeds the state cap, or after all 15 L5 detectors. No size extension.
decision: Do not promote the nested suffix contraction. Observing 7 of 15 L5 charges requires 1,646,646 peak states and still improves no p=.08 activity interval; the registered 9-charge run exceeds the two-million-state cap at 5,461,398 states.
next_action: Develop a scalable l1 tensor/decision-diagram contraction or a certified branch-and-bound over charge records. Do not approximate the already exact finite-harmonic edge kernel or enlarge the capped prefix matrix.
